memories: 走廊盡頭有一棵大榕樹
從來不叫我名字的導師
貼在布告欄上的月考排名
memories_en: A big banyan tree right past the end of the corridor
A homeroom teacher who never called me by name
The monthly exam rankings pinned on the bulletin board

pa.zh: 請今天的值日生，現在到教師辦公室一趟。
pa.en: The student on duty today, please come to the teachers' office now.

cards.title: 燈暗了走廊變長
cards.whisper: 後面的路，比剛才更長了。
cards.title_en: The Light Went Out and the Corridor Lengthened
cards.whisper_en: The way behind is longer than before.

edits.corridor: Make the nearest long white fluorescent tube light above the stone sinks dark and unlit, stretch the corridor beyond it to be far too long, leave all the brown wooden classroom doors on the right standing ajar, and make the banyan canopy at the corridor end hang lower with one aerial root touching the floor.
edits.door: Place the red duty bucket with the string mop standing inside the classroom among the wooden-topped student desks where it could not be, with a wet mop trail running up the white wall beside the green sliding door, and show the same green sliding door repeating into the distance inside.
edits.office: On top of one wooden teacher's desk, place the small red duty bucket where it could not be, with a wet mop trail running up the side of the desk.

cards.title: 門牌歪了沒名字
cards.title_en: The Name Holder Hangs Crooked and Empty
cards.whisper_en: It remembers you, but will not call you.

edits.corridor: Make one long white fluorescent tube light in the middle dark, stretch the corridor beyond it far too long, leave every brown wooden classroom door on the right standing ajar, and show the same brown door repeating into the distance at the far end.
edits.door: Leave the clear empty name-plate holder on the white wall beside the green sliding door hanging crooked and slightly open, place the red bucket with the mop standing on the wooden shoe cabinet where it could not be, with the wet mop trail running up the wall beside the cabinet.
edits.office: Hang a small clear empty name-plate holder crooked and slightly open on the edge of a wooden teacher's desk, with the brown wooden attendance clipboard lying beside it.

cards.title: 排名掉下一張紙
cards.whisper: 有一張，從上面滑下來了。
cards.whisper_en: One sheet has slipped down from the top.

edits.corridor: Make the farthest long white fluorescent tube light dark, stretch the corridor beyond it far too long, leave all brown wooden classroom doors on the right standing ajar, and make one blank white ranking sheet on the cork bulletin board on the right slip down hanging by a single pin.
edits.door: Show the same green sliding classroom door repeating into the distance through the open doorway, with the wet mop trail running up the white pillar beside the wooden shoe cabinet and the red bucket standing inside the classroom doorway where it could not be.
edits.office: Pin one blank white ranking sheet slipping down by a single pin on a cork board in the office, with every office door left ajar in the background.

cards.title: 榕樹垂下遮住走廊
cards.whisper: 大家都還坐在那裡，等你。
cards.title_en: The Banyan Hangs Over the Corridor
cards.whisper_en: They are all still sitting there, waiting for you.

edits.corridor: At the far corridor end where the banyan tree is visible, add many thick hanging aerial roots down across the opening like a dark curtain with leaves pressing against the corridor end, clearly visible beyond the open wooden doors.
edits.door: Drape a Taiwanese white short-sleeved uniform shirt with navy trim on the back of every visible wooden student desk chair seen through the open green sliding door, no faces, no crests, no text.
edits.classroom: Across the wet classroom floor between the wooden student desks, add long dark shadows of a whole seated class with nobody casting them, clearly visible stretching from the empty chairs.

cards.title: 空名牌掉在門下
cards.title_en: The Empty Name Tag Fell Down
cards.whisper_en: The teacher never once called your name.

edits.corridor: On the right side of the corridor, hang a Taiwanese white short-sleeved shirt with navy trim and a pleated navy-plaid skirt on each of the three wooden-topped student desks, and turn all three desks to face the camera.
edits.door: Below the green sliding door on the right, show the small clear empty name-plate holder fallen on the wet floor, lit by harsh light, still empty with no text, next to the pair of white sneakers.
edits.classroom: Push every wooden-topped student desk with steel legs to the sides of the classroom away from one single desk left alone in the center foreground, and turn every wooden chair to face the camera.

cards.title: 排名紙散滿一地
cards.whisper_en: The exam papers are stacked to the ceiling.

edits.corridor: On the corridor bulletin board on the right, make many blank white ranking sheets without text slip, curl and fall off, lying scattered across the shiny corridor floor below the board.
edits.door: Inside the classroom seen through the green door, stack tall piles of blank textless exam papers without readable text on top of the wooden student desks up toward the ceiling.
edits.classroom: Stack blank textless exam papers to the ceiling on the wooden teacher desk under the green chalkboard, and in the dark open doorway on the right far away add a dark adult silhouette with its back turned wearing a beige cardigan, no face visible.

memories: 走廊盡頭有一棵大榕樹
從來不叫我名字的導師
貼在布告欄上的月考排名
memories_en: A big banyan tree right past the end of the corridor
A homeroom teacher who never called me by name
The monthly exam rankings pinned on the bulletin board
changes_en: The Light Went Out and the Corridor Lengthened
The Empty Name Tag Fell Down
ending.comment: 走廊長了燈暗了，空名牌掉了，榕樹還在。別管排名了，孩子，老師看見你了。
ending.comment_en: The corridor grew long and dim, the empty tag fell, yet the banyan remains. Forget the rankings, child, I see you now.
